product.title: Boston Sunset Harbor Cruise

description.text: Watch the Boston skyline turn gold on a narrated sunset harbor cruise departing from Long Wharf. Your guide points out the Custom House Tower, Seaport District, and Charlestown Navy Yard as the light fades over Boston Harbor. The 90-minute format pairs harbor breezes with skyline photography without committing a full evening. Ideal for couples and first-time visitors who want a relaxed waterfront perspective after daytime downtown sightseeing.

highlights: Sunset harbor cruise from Long Wharf
